endorsements.name: Yuqing Zhang
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-5001
endorsements.description: A vulnerability was found in GNU PSPP 82fb509fb2fedd33e7ac0c46ca99e108bb3bdffb. It has been declared as problematic. This vulnerability affects the function calloc of the file pspp-convert.c. The manipulation of the argument -l leads to integer overflow. Local access is required to approach this attack. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 4.8)
